Landscape 16:9. STRICT DIRECTLY OVERHEAD 90-degree top-down camera, like a tabletop terrain map, no horizon, no isometric or three-quarter view. Large quiet traversable rocky center taking most of frame for game icons, details concentrated near edges. No characters, enemies, text, numbers, UI, grid lines or drawn paths. Apex ascent floor 1: broad lower basalt terrace, warm rust and charcoal stone, thin orange lava channels around outer perimeter, sparse violet crystal clusters and craggy edges. Modest height with rocky ground beyond edges.

Create a production 16:9 background painting for Astrata's mind grid. Dark painterly fantasy, realistic textured rocks, violet/cyan crystals, distant volcanic mountain lava. A VERY SMALL intimate druid meditation nook on a cliff ledge, only about two meters across, with a worn rectangular cloth mat on flat stone, a few close-up candles, one little incense bowl and a closed grimoire framing the sides. Camera looking down steeply at the mat; most of the picture is the quiet textured mat and ledge on which cards will be overlaid, objects at human hand scale. Beyond the far edge of the ledge a small portion of the frame reveals a vertiginous drop and distant lava/crystal mountain, showing intimacy versus vast distant landscape. Not a battlefield or arena, no gigantic platform, no people, no cards, no grid, no lettering or UI. Cozy candlelight against dangerous mountain, high detail on nearby ritual objects.
